description.en: Hold the knife, push, blow the dust away

howToPlay.zh: 照着篆刻师傅的工序刻一方四字印：先倒边，再刻边框、刻十字分成四格，最后一笔一笔刻字。按住刻刀拖动就是移刀，把刀尖放到稿线的一端，点底部的「下刀」，刀压进石头；这时在屏幕任意位置顺着线划就是刻，上下左右四个方向都行：每一划的第一下定方向，刀从停下的地方一顿一顿地吃进去，往回划会顺着刻过的槽退回。抬起手指刀留在石头里，再划一次接着刻；点「提刀」回到移刀。刻偏了点「撤销」去掉最后一划，可以连续撤销；「重刻」可以只重刻当前这一步，或者整方从头再来。‹ › 转动印石。刻完按「吹」把石粉吹干净，印石转一圈展示，印蜕收进右上角的「印谱」，同时解锁下一方。印面上刻的是反字，盖出来才是正的。电脑上：按住刻刀拖动是移刀，下刀后按住左键顺着线拖就是刻。键盘：方向键移刀，空格下刀或提刀，下刀后按方向键顺着线推、反方向往回拉，Z 撤销，Q 和 E 转动印石，B 吹粉，A 打开印谱。
howToPlay.en: Carve a four-character seal the way a seal carver does: chamfer the face's edges, cut the border, cut a cross into four cells, then carve the characters stroke by stroke. Hold the knife and drag to move it. Set its tip at one end of a draft line and press Cut at the bottom: the knife goes into the stone, and now a swipe anywhere carves along the line, up, down, left or right. The first part of each swipe sets its direction; the knife bites in from where it stands, flake by flake, and swiping back slides it down its own groove. Lifting your finger leaves the knife in for the next swipe; press Lift to move it again. Undo takes back the last swipe, again and again; Redo starts the current step, or the whole seal, over. ‹ › turn the stone. When all is cut, Blow clears the powder, the stone turns once, and the print goes into Seals (top right) and the next seal opens. The face is carved mirrored so that it prints the right way round. With a mouse: drag the knife to move it; with it in, hold the button and drag along a line to carve. Keyboard: arrow keys move the knife, Space puts it in or lifts it; with it in, an arrow pushes along a line and the opposite one pulls back; Z undoes, Q and E turn the stone, B blows, A opens your seals.
